selection_basis: Highest validation PR-AUC among LSTM, GRU, and Transformer (Stage 9).
note: The Transformer achieved the best validation PR-AUC among the three sequence-aware architectures evaluated. It was compared empirically against the XGBoost classical baseline on the frozen held-out test set. XGBoost outperformed the Transformer on PR-AUC and Brier score on this dataset. The Transformer is retained as the sequence-aware research contribution, preserving the longitudinal modelling capability for future research.
warnings: Sequence-aware models were not assumed to outperform classical baselines. Comparative performance was determined empirically.
The Transformer was not the primary deployment model but is retained as the best sequence-aware research contribution.
